name: ship-supercarrot
summary: Player ship shaped like a flying carrot: a round orange tapering root, point forward, with one big eye and a three-leaf green tuft behind; organic and round.

traits: dark socket recessed into the root
brown eyeball bulging out of it
about half as tall as wide above the root
features.note: The single brown eye in the middle of the root (rows 9-13, columns 9-13); a sunken socket with a round eyeball in it.

traits: small round spot on top of the eyeball
features.note: The glowing pupil at column 11, row 11; must stay bright.

traits: tapers from the flat top (row 18) to a point at row 0
about as tall as it is wide
features.note: The carrot root: a round tapered cone, not a flat slab.

traits: light yellow band across the root at row 14
a raised ring round the root
features.note: The bright ridge ring below the eye; a raised band, not just paint.

traits: light yellow rings at rows 6 and 8
features.note: The light bands round the upper root; carrot ridges.
The pointed tip of the carrot at the front.

traits: thin, tapered, with a light midrib
features.note: The middle leaf of the tuft, straight back.

traits: fans out to column 6 at row 25
features.note: The left leaf of the tuft.

traits: fans out to column 15 at row 23
features.note: The right leaf of the tuft.

traits: dark red flat top of the root at row 18
features.note: The flat back end of the root where the stem starts.

concept.source: Gemini (Nano Banana) high-res reimagining of the level-frame sprite, 2026-10-28, with the user's prompt (same overhead outline, don't take pixels literally)
concept.use: Design guide for what each part is and its shape language; the sprite decides the top-view outline, proportions and colours.
